name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
cycle_quote: For the 2026–2027 application, we’re asking these short answer essay questions:

prompts.text: What field of study appeals to you the most right now? (Note: Applicants select from a drop-down list.) Reflect on what has led you to this interest.
prompts.quote: Depending on the question, we’re looking for responses of approximately 100–200 words each.

prompts.text: While some reach their goals following well-trodden paths, others blaze their own trails achieving the unexpected. In what ways have you done something different than what was expected in your educational journey?
prompts.quote: Depending on the question, we’re looking for responses of approximately 100–200 words each.

prompts.text: How have your personal and academic experiences influenced the types of problems you would want to tackle with an MIT education and the impact you aim to make on your community?
prompts.quote: Depending on the question, we’re looking for responses of approximately 100–200 words each.

prompts.text: How did you manage a situation or challenge that you didn’t expect? What did you learn from it?
prompts.quote: Depending on the question, we’re looking for responses of approximately 100–200 words each.

prompts.text: What do you do just for fun?
prompts.quote: There is only space for 40 to 50 words each.

prompts.text: Who is someone you admire, whether you know them personally or look up to them from afar? Tell us why.
prompts.quote: There is only space for 40 to 50 words each.

prompts.text: What’s a topic, academic or non-academic, that you could talk about for hours?
prompts.quote: There is only space for 40 to 50 words each.

prompts.text: MIT values both “generalists” with varied interests and “specialists” who focus deeply on one or a few passions. Which do you think best describes you, and why?
prompts.quote: There is only space for 40 to 50 words each.

prompts.text: Please use our form, not a resume, to list your activities. There is only enough space to list four things—please choose the four that mean the most to you and tell us a bit about them.
prompts.quote: Please use our form, not a resume, to list your activities.
